en.headline: Minibus driver dies after collapsing while boarding passengers in Kwai Chung
en.dek: Police said a man in his 70s was found unconscious on a green minibus at Shek Yam Road around 5:54pm on Saturday and was certified dead at Yan Chai Hospital later that evening.
body: Police said a green minibus driver collapsed and later died while the vehicle was stopped for passengers in Kwai Chung on Saturday evening.

Officers received a report from a passenger at about 5:54pm that a driver was unconscious on a route 401 minibus outside the North Kwai Chung Market at 116 Shek Yam Road. Rescuers found the man in a coma and took him to Yan Chai Hospital, where he was certified dead at 7:49pm.
The minibus was on the service between Shek Yam Estate and Tsing Yi Pier. The driver, aged about 70, had already completed several trips that day. Police are investigating the cause of the collapse.

zh.headline: 葵涌綠Van司機上客期間暈倒 送院搶救後不治
zh.dek: 警方表示，周六傍晚約5時54分，一名年約七旬男司機在石蔭路小巴站上客時被發現昏迷，送仁濟醫院後於晚上7時49分證實死亡。
body: 警方表示，一名綠色專線小巴司機周六傍晚在葵涌石蔭路上客期間突然暈倒，送院搶救後不治。
警方於傍晚約5時54分接獲乘客報案，指在石蔭路116號北葵涌街市對開的401號線小巴上，發現司機不省人事。救援人員到場後證實司機陷入昏迷，隨即將他送往仁濟醫院，延至晚上7時49分被證實死亡。
涉事小巴來往石蔭邨及青衣碼頭。警方正在調查司機暈倒原因。事主年約七旬，當日已駕駛數趟。
